module.purpose: Defines a reusable React component that emits browser speculation rules for hover-triggered prefetching and prerendering.
module.summary: This module prepares a speculation rules object from optional prefetch and prerender path lists, assigning moderate eagerness to both behaviors. It serializes the configuration as JSON and injects it through Next.js Script using the browser's speculationrules script type. Empty arrays are used when callers omit either path list.
module.businessContext: Improves perceived navigation speed in the web application by allowing browsers to prefetch or prerender likely destinations. Failure removes these performance optimizations but does not block normal navigation.
functions: SpeculationRules (~L3-34): Builds and injects browser speculation rules for hover navigation paths
systemCapabilities: Inject speculation rules into document markup

io: Emits a Next.js Script element containing serialized speculation rules.

detail.name: SpeculationRules
preconditions: prefetchPathsOnHover, when provided, is an array of strings.
prerenderPathsOnHover, when provided, is an array of strings.
postconditions: Returns a Script element with id "speculation-rules" and type "speculationrules".
The Script element's inline content is the JSON serialization of a speculation-rules object containing the supplied prefetch and prerender URL arrays.
Both prefetch and prerender rule entries have eagerness set to "moderate".
invariants: The input path arrays are preserved as the corresponding urls arrays.
The generated speculation-rules object always contains both prefetch and prerender keys.
edgeCases: When either path prop is omitted, its urls array defaults to [].
When either path prop is an empty array, the corresponding rule entry contains an empty urls array.
Path strings are serialized as provided without filtering or normalization.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns a Script element with id="speculation-rules" and type="speculationrules". Its dangerouslySetInnerHTML.__html value is JSON.stringify({"prefetch":[{"urls":<prefetchPathsOnHover>,"eagerness":"moderate"}],"prerender":[{"urls":<prerenderPathsOnHover>,"eagerness":"moderate"}]}) without additional wrapping or formatting.
detail.summary: Creates a Script element containing speculation rules for moderate-eagerness prefetching and prerendering of the supplied paths.

specLiterals.role: Speculation rule eagerness for both prefetch and prerender entries.
Script type identifying the inline content as speculation rules.
Stable id assigned to the returned Script element.

specTests.then: The returned Script element has id "speculation-rules", type "speculationrules", and inline JSON content representing prefetch urls ["/about"] and prerender urls ["/checkout"], with eagerness "moderate" for both.
The inline JSON content contains prefetch and prerender entries whose urls arrays are both empty.
